title: Career Roadmap · Makeup Artist
summary: A Makeup Artist applies professional makeup for everyday beauty, bridal events, photography, film, television and fashion, combining technical skills with colour theory, hygiene and client consultation.

facts.Current degree: ITI Hair & Skin Care / Cosmetology / Beauty

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Complete Class 10 for eligible vocational courses.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: No specific stream is generally required for many makeup-training routes.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Skin preparation, colour theory, face shapes, hygiene and product knowledge.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Day makeup, evening looks, blending, base matching and eye makeup.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced practice
blocks.text: Bridal, editorial and photography makeup; practise under supervision.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Build a portfolio, learn client consultation, price services and develop professional communication.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Bridal-look portfolio • Before-and-after makeup collection with client consent • Makeup kit and hygiene checklist • Sample service menu and pricing sheet.

blocks.label: Typical pathway

blocks.text: Freelance work, professional licensing and visa conditions vary by country. International employment and sponsorship are not guaranteed.

Student ↓ Makeup Trainee ↓ Makeup Assistant ↓ Junior Makeup Artist ↓ Professional Makeup Artist ↓ Bridal / Fashion / Media Specialist ↓ Senior Artist / Makeup Trainer ↓ Studio Owner / Creative Director

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ COSMETOLOGY OR PROFESSIONAL MAKEUP COURSE ↓ MAKEUP TECHNIQUES + HYGIENE ↓ PRACTICAL PROJECTS + PORTFOLIO ↓ ASSISTANT ROLE / INTERNSHIP ↓ PROFESSIONAL MAKEUP ARTIST ↓ SPECIALIZATION + CLIENT NETWORK ↓ FREELANCE BUSINESS / STUDIO / SENIOR ROLE
Verify current official notifications for admissions, course recognition, scholarships and international requirements. Prioritize practical training, hygiene, portfolio quality and client consent.
